description: This file defines a Java interface, PreparedTimer, which extends other interfaces related to metrics instrumentation, specifically for timing metrics. It provides method signatures for starting, recording, and retrieving timing data in a metrics collection system.

classes.name: PreparedTimer
classes.description: An interface representing a prepared timer metric that can be started, record durations, and provide total and record counts.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the timer, returning a StartedTimer instance. This method is package-private and intended for use by the DefaultTimerBuilder.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records a given duration expressed in a specified TimeUnit into the timer.

methods.name: getTotalTime
methods.description: Returns the sum of all recorded times in nanoseconds.

methods.name: getNumberOfRecords
methods.description: Returns the total number of recorded timings.
